Garage description
The original idea was to show only one constellation on this color. A lot of tankers were interviewed to define the most popular constellation. In the end it was decided to let one constellation emerge after the other to meet everyone's wishes. Did you find your favorite constellation?
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
This paint was added to the game on June 16th, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 33 of the June 2020 Challenge B.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
With update 640, released March 19, 2021, Constellation received a unique Garage description.
